% Blending weight (Shimizu+22 eq.\ 15)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_xi}
\xi_\mathrm{rad}(p) = \max\!\bigl(0,\,1 - p_\mathrm{chr}/p\bigr)\ \in [0, 1),\quad p_\mathrm{chr} \approx 0.1\,p_\odot
\end{equation}

% Total cooling
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_blend}
Q_R(T, \rho, p) = \xi_\mathrm{rad}(p)\,Q_R^\mathrm{thck}(T, \rho) + (1 - \xi_\mathrm{rad}(p))\,Q_R^\mathrm{thin}(T, \rho, Z)
\end{equation}

% Gudiksen-Nordlund 2005 Newton cooling (thick)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_GN05}
Q_R^\mathrm{thck} = (e_\mathrm{int} - e_\mathrm{int}^\mathrm{ref}) / \tau_\mathrm{thck},\quad \tau_\mathrm{thck}(\rho) = 0.1\,(\rho/\bar{\rho})^{-1/2}\ \mathrm{s}
\end{equation}

% Newton cooling closed-form relaxation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_relax}
T(t) = T_\mathrm{ref} + (T_0 - T_\mathrm{ref})\,\exp(-t/\tau_\mathrm{thck})
\end{equation}

% Anderson-Athay 1989 chromospheric law (Suzuki+25 eq.\ 17)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_AA}
Q_R^\mathrm{AA} = 4.5\!\times\!10^9\,(0.2 + 0.8\,Z/Z_\odot)\,\min(1,\,\rho/\rho_\mathrm{cr})\ \mathrm{erg\,cm^{-3}\,s^{-1}},\quad \rho_\mathrm{cr} = 10^{-16}\,\mathrm{g\,cm^{-3}}
\end{equation}

% Two-piece thin cooling
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_twopiece}
Q_R^\mathrm{thin}(T, \rho, Z) = \begin{cases}Q_R^\mathrm{SD93}(T, Z)\ n_e n_i, & T > 1.2\!\times\!10^4\,\mathrm{K} \\Q_R^\mathrm{AA}(\rho, Z), & T \le 1.2\!\times\!10^4\,\mathrm{K} \\0, & T \le T_\mathrm{cut} = 0.7\,T_\mathrm{eff}\end{cases}
\end{equation}

% Explicit-source CFL
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_CFL}
\Delta t_\mathrm{rad}^\mathrm{thck} \le \beta_\mathrm{thck}\,\tau_\mathrm{thck},\quad \beta_\mathrm{thck} \approx 0.3\text{ (backward-Euler handles }\beta \to \infty\text{)}
\end{equation}

% ξ-boundary smoothness (C^∞ alternative)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C8_smooth}
\xi_\mathrm{rad}^\mathrm{smooth}(p) = \tfrac{1}{2}\bigl[1 + \tanh\!\bigl((p - p_\mathrm{chr})/\Delta p\bigr)\bigr]\ \Longrightarrow\ \text{no sharp }C^0\text{ at }p = p_\mathrm{chr}
\end{equation}
